Elevated liver enzymes—most commonly alanine transaminase (ALT), aspartate transaminase (AST), alkaline phosphatase (ALP), and gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase (GGT)—usually indicate liver cell inflammation, stress, or injury . Common causes include `fatty liver disease, alcohol use, medications, and viral hepatitis`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF153jbYEbC1TpNjumTJGQfAIL7eoE2PlO9PQqUy9jxdN37tgFvahn-NKTThtLh_4K5g7b49DRqsld0QFJX5jFD2evaN97p2KQnoy4bLvQcKZUPdzKL4ZpSI24LFKnpJP-JFV9tc5SgdbRGXf7fgDoUV5ZWVFZYhACDJNbUhYsQkDgeEm_NqbVCoyF0sAm7w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF11fwVMW28_gchPc-ML1hX3o9khqVA-Zb8SVYHn83fUO6JuOR9cf99PBUrDSl3QIFaQTUJuDavNMFGCI2PTkzxIbAybPpLwXRUN2G1KHzk7u_ctnNtt7oqEdig1zb83pvvJm3T5F-HHIB4dl3i3hxlobbV0O6WMpuEvsPeMv3pIRXMQkY)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1--1ok33Wi_8cgm9ZxJtFcFLtQZCoHRkEw-macPj7QquNumsY3NaBz891p66fuTT1XwX5v4AO49ZiVU6XqRSmvkBq_6vNo6GuTdtD9zsC-tHOVasu-ACCkd5MnUR1xobGdvUAF-7SL2j8GvNOLU6kZXbWeVagANqQR6ojVKVkx2FP2QkJSOh96VAARuXG81rqobc_ABWFecjcb0C3_r5cauLYiPf6cdGvBm3w3mR1w)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1wteahKRu3gnZTbzezMOeUyZihu06XGh6590MVlKwqL5KCtAsXEXe57kZNWS-H0sxlMv55tY522RkyW-NJdgXgjoNQNPgNuiQqaTD-o4WEzjuG7wn2JQwEatDPGnx708fHpKkWX2VLseWvQg4GZpHe8ODimhbbGxxIYUcAUP)

### Most Common Causes

- **Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD):** Excess fat buildup in the liver, often tied to higher body weight, insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes, high cholesterol, or high triglycerides.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1--1ok33Wi_8cgm9ZxJtFcFLtQZCoHRkEw-macPj7QquNumsY3NaBz891p66fuTT1XwX5v4AO49ZiVU6XqRSmvkBq_6vNo6GuTdtD9zsC-tHOVasu-ACCkd5MnUR1xobGdvUAF-7SL2j8GvNOLU6kZXbWeVagANqQR6ojVKVkx2FP2QkJSOh96VAARuXG81rqobc_ABWFecjcb0C3_r5cauLYiPf6cdGvBm3w3mR1w)
- **Alcohol use:** Heavy or long-term drinking can irritate or damage liver cells and cause alcohol-related liver disease.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF19B-R-KW6zZiORG_5aPxjz9v41_7kMkd0mJOvrP_w3ArvvpjH7RxtyucJMqMmCXIsHFzQpbC3DG192WEVJcx4cdu0EGUoQnZArL3CCvgprn3zqFJxZk5s0O8jRSNf-3DaA51SB9sGFa2MRutKTrIu8O8ykD_kKZwewS-kb_EzAriU4zJmZIiiLphY9kGuIE5)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1--1ok33Wi_8cgm9ZxJtFcFLtQZCoHRkEw-macPj7QquNumsY3NaBz891p66fuTT1XwX5v4AO49ZiVU6XqRSmvkBq_6vNo6GuTdtD9zsC-tHOVasu-ACCkd5MnUR1xobGdvUAF-7SL2j8GvNOLU6kZXbWeVagANqQR6ojVKVkx2FP2QkJSOh96VAARuXG81rqobc_ABWFecjcb0C3_r5cauLYiPf6cdGvBm3w3mR1w)
- **Medications and supplements:** Over-the-counter pain relievers (especially acetaminophen), certain prescription drugs (like statins, antibiotics, or seizure medications), and herbal supplements can raise enzyme levels.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF153jbYEbC1TpNjumTJGQfAIL7eoE2PlO9PQqUy9jxdN37tgFvahn-NKTThtLh_4K5g7b49DRqsld0QFJX5jFD2evaN97p2KQnoy4bLvQcKZUPdzKL4ZpSI24LFKnpJP-JFV9tc5SgdbRGXf7fgDoUV5ZWVFZYhACDJNbUhYsQkDgeEm_NqbVCoyF0sAm7w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1--1ok33Wi_8cgm9ZxJtFcFLtQZCoHRkEw-macPj7QquNumsY3NaBz891p66fuTT1XwX5v4AO49ZiVU6XqRSmvkBq_6vNo6GuTdtD9zsC-tHOVasu-ACCkd5MnUR1xobGdvUAF-7SL2j8GvNOLU6kZXbWeVagANqQR6ojVKVkx2FP2QkJSOh96VAARuXG81rqobc_ABWFecjcb0C3_r5cauLYiPf6cdGvBm3w3mR1w)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAIBxCJF13tb9G4d8iMKzBvlz4en1kFbProfUl8nXJVI8TMKSmEvb0kvtG6AFwIcDKlW8JMC2GFuOHg-8KB-_s-H28T4GEBDkm-L_f872yiNbuo3sBJsI_EBoXAMjBNUedtzNIg0aLz8vMqOfm3xCk33pxFClJJavVGstpWy92v1kZykllaiR4MmRLLt1bUP5d9num4AvdmsLgcZ96MfBpxf7zDJiKuyCnh9aD_ubeC-yCPOT-WrXThYBLOsAQ7xwYHeJdjMofXkyyhzJv63o_A1SJ5DspuLMizyypQaPGh699IRrZJAYubMIrczc1S8NiCX4ptHrGWsq59D0Q4-vEpU-rg6t3SyZi02Lawm8MfPRz2BiJdOmqwIhRkJhUM_Pjg)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UVco0M7mpqs&t=59)
- **Viral hepatitis:** Infections such as hepatitis A, B, or C cause liver inflammation.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF153jbYEbC1TpNjumTJGQfAIL7eoE2PlO9PQqUy9jxdN37tgFvahn-NKTThtLh_4K5g7b49DRqsld0QFJX5jFD2evaN97p2KQnoy4bLvQcKZUPdzKL4ZpSI24LFKnpJP-JFV9tc5SgdbRGXf7fgDoUV5ZWVFZYhACDJNbUhYsQkDgeEm_NqbVCoyF0sAm7w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF19B-R-KW6zZiORG_5aPxjz9v41_7kMkd0mJOvrP_w3ArvvpjH7RxtyucJMqMmCXIsHFzQpbC3DG192WEVJcx4cdu0EGUoQnZArL3CCvgprn3zqFJxZk5s0O8jRSNf-3DaA51SB9sGFa2MRutKTrIu8O8ykD_kKZwewS-kb_EzAriU4zJmZIiiLphY9kGuIE5)

### Less Common & Underlying Conditions

- **Other infections and conditions:** Epstein-Barr virus (mononucleosis), cytomegalovirus, celiac disease, thyroid disorders, heart failure, bile duct blockages, or liver tumors.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX-iJppc_EGNEPdQxPs2UgllBH5PpA4RdRM8wS0cbOcBqjV4Zm0ylZ_fh9Vh_8aiZ7HN2Cz6ZCS6BFZsP2IAEXOGnSqtKDrPAs5vtrFntHQUlE3yVD0OZBbaW8oalxRFzgCxCUZckCys8A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF153jbYEbC1TpNjumTJGQfAIL7eoE2PlO9PQqUy9jxdN37tgFvahn-NKTThtLh_4K5g7b49DRqsld0QFJX5jFD2evaN97p2KQnoy4bLvQcKZUPdzKL4ZpSI24LFKnpJP-JFV9tc5SgdbRGXf7fgDoUV5ZWVFZYhACDJNbUhYsQkDgeEm_NqbVCoyF0sAm7w)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXX5y7fT3QPfcZjTr_ZP52yiO5hft3OviW_e5czczZkzyXBBeVC8wjGk_WdmsntLME_7f6_aCPDz7SHnZ9MRSxRoCNv5hE_6k-sCgKyBtstofOqcwi9R7RkDx0ZR04r)

### Temporary & Non-Liver Factors
Mild elevations can sometimes be short-term and resolve on their own or after addressing a trigger. items.text: Autoimmune and bile duct conditions: Autoimmune hepatitis, primary biliary cholangitis, or primary sclerosing cholangitis. Other infections and conditions: Epstein-Barr virus (mononucleosis), cytomegalovirus, celiac disease, thyroid disorders, heart failure, bile duct blockages, or liver tumors.
